acceptance_criteria: Worker cp_inventory_collect and other enrolled-device jobs do not fail with connect_failed: host_key_rejected: TRUST_ENTRY_MISSING
PersistedManagementEndpointTrustResolver falls back to enrolled device trust (or enrolledDevices resolver) when no active endpoint trust is found in management_endpoint_ssh_trust
WorkerClaimLoop and SshExecTransport properly resolve host key trust for enrolled devices without requiring pre-discovery trust entries
Strict host key checking is preserved (no TOFU / no accept-all), and all worker unit tests pass

baseline.observed: Job cp_inventory_collect fails with connect_failed: host_key_rejected: TRUST_ENTRY_MISSING (e.g. job 2f61ab69-d08f-40ef-8bf1-8a7768fe6d8d on device fc291462-1400-432a-8b10-8a2700d1301f)
baseline.what_exists: WorkerClaimLoop uses PersistedManagementEndpointTrustResolver.scopeRef which queries management_endpoint_ssh_trust. When no row exists for the endpoint, authorizedAlgorithms returns empty list which causes SshExecTransport to immediately abort with TRUST_ENTRY_MISSING without checking enrolled device trust or environment trust rule.

invariants: No security weakening: strict host key checking must be preserved; never default to trust-on-first-use or accept-any
Fail-closed security: unknown fingerprints must still be rejected
report.objective: Fix TRUST_ENTRY_MISSING error in worker for cp_inventory_collect and other enrolled device jobs. Ensure PersistedManagementEndpointTrustResolver and WorkerClaimLoop support both discovery endpoint trust and enrolled device trust fallback.

recommended_reasoning.reason: Fixing critical SSH host key trust resolution in worker

requirements: In PersistedManagementEndpointTrustResolver, if repository.findActiveAlgorithms returns empty or no fingerprint is found in management_endpoint_ssh_trust, delegate to enrolledDevices resolver rather than returning an empty list that aborts connection.
Ensure WorkerClaimLoop and SshExecTransport allow enrolled device collection when trust is defined via enrolledDevices or when management_endpoint_ssh_trust has no entry.
Verify that worker unit tests pass including PersistedManagementEndpointTrustResolverTest.
risks: Accidental weakening of SSH host key verification if fail-closed checks are removed

changed: PersistedManagementEndpointTrustResolver delegates absent discovery fingerprints and algorithms to enrolled-device trust.
completed: Added enrolled-device trust fallback when active discovery endpoint trust is absent.
Added regression coverage for accepted enrolled trust and rejected rotated keys.
